summary: Tested Conversational English title and lesson-plan folder organization against the public URL. Folder create/list/update, move, filtering, count updates, deletion, and unfiled behavior work end to end. The title field renders and accepts input, but the backend drops title during create/update, so the saved plan reloads with an empty title. Focused backend tests passed 5/7; blank folder names are also accepted.

critical.issue: Conversational English title is accepted by LessonPlanCreate but omitted from create_plan and update_plan persistence dictionaries. POST returned title=null and GET returned title=null, so user-entered titles are lost.

minor.issue: POST accepts a whitespace-only name, strips it to an empty string, persists it, and returns HTTP 200 instead of validation error.

ui_bugs.issue: Each folder is rendered as a button containing another button for its menu. React reports invalid nested <button> markup and a hydration warning; the icon-only menu also has no accessible name or data-testid.

Opening both dialogs emits Radix warnings because DialogContent has no DialogDescription or explicit aria-describedby configuration; several color, cancel, move-target, edit, and delete controls also lack data-testid attributes.

integration_issues.flow: Create and save a Conversational English plan with a title
integration_issues.issue: The title input appears and accepts text, POST succeeds and navigates to the saved plan, but the title field reloads empty because API responses persist title as null.

issues: The page heading remains 'Weekly Plan' after selecting Conversational English.
Lesson Date Range uses native browser date inputs rather than the application's calendar component.

action_items: Persist title in both create_plan and update_plan, then verify POST/PUT/GET and UI reload preserve it; also persist folder_id on plan creation if that model field is intended to be supported.
Constrain PlanFolderCreate.name to trimmed non-empty text and reject blank values with 422.
Replace the nested folder buttons with sibling controls and give icon-only/menu/dialog controls accessible names and data-testid attributes.
Add DialogDescription or explicit aria-describedby handling to folder dialogs.
Build frontend API URLs from process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL instead of window.location.origin.
critical_code_review_comments: LessonPlanCreate/Response define title and folder_id, but server.py create_plan/update_plan manually enumerate fields and omit title; create_plan also omits folder_id. Updating only Pydantic models does not persist either field.
PlanFolderCreate uses unconstrained str and strips only after validation, allowing an empty persisted folder name.
PlannerList.js lines 272-305 place DropdownMenuTrigger's button inside the folder selection button, producing invalid interactive nesting and observed React hydration warnings.
PlannerList.js and LessonPlanner.js derive API from window.location.origin, contrary to the required REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL deployment contract.
LessonPlanner.js is 2,706 lines, far above the 700-line maintainability limit; extract Conversational English, templates, AI, and weekly-plan sections into focused components.

PlannerList initial loading uses one Promise.all and only console.error on failure, so one failed folder request hides plans/classes too and presents an empty screen without a user-visible error state.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created isolated TEST_ folders and plans and removed them in fixture teardown. Browser testing created a transient teacher, class, two plans, and folder; plans/folder/class were cleaned through APIs and the user/school/session were removed directly from MongoDB. No test data remains.
test_credentials: The supplied test@school.edu credentials authenticate but redirect /planner to pricing because the trial is expired. E2E feature testing used a transient teacher account that was fully removed afterward.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Re-run: pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v -k 'plan_folder or conversational_english_title or move_plan_to_folder or delete_folder_moves or move_plan_rejects'. On UI, create/select Conversational English, fill ce-title-input, save, and assert the input and planner card retain the title after reload. Folder E2E create/move/filter/delete passed.
rca_of_the_issue: The title defect is deterministic: LessonPlanner includes title in its payload and the Pydantic model parses it, but server.py constructs plan_doc/update_data field by field without title. MongoDB therefore never receives it and LessonPlanResponse supplies the optional default null. Blank folders occur because name is stripped only while constructing folder_doc, with no post-strip non-empty validation.
